name: paradoc
author: paradoc
abstract: Author, fill, validate, render and seal Paradoc artifacts (forms, documents, checklists, bundles) on every surface: the TypeScript SDK, the paradoc CLI, raw JSON/YAML, the AI agent tools (@paradoc/ai-tools and its adapters) and the hosted MCP server. Topic references for fields, parties, annexes, logic, layers, templates, PDF bindings, rendering, formatting, instructions, filling and sealing, and one staged workflow for creating a form or converting a PDF form.
